{
  "name": "loss_exp_advantage_gap",
  "intuition": "shift from margin-based to exponential preference weighting: use advantage_gap as signal weight with an exponential penalty on negative margin, encouraging larger winning log-prob gaps amplified by advantage magnitude",
  "pseudocode": "margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\npos_mask = margin > 0\nloss = exp(-margin) * advantage_gap * pos_mask\nloss = mean(weight * loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_weighted_penalty",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "exponential",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "nonnegative_mask"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "exp",
    "mul",
    "sub",
    "mean",
    "max",
    "sign"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    ag = batch['advantage_gap']\n    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)  # log_prob_w - log_prob_l\n    zero = ops.zeros_like(margin)\n    pos_mask = ops.max(ops.sign(margin), zero)  # 1 if margin>0 else 0\n    base_loss = ops.mul(ops.exp(ops.neg(margin)), ag)  # exp(-margin)*advantage_gap\n    loss = ops.mul(base_loss, pos_mask)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_000_cost_shifted_agg",
  "intuition": "pairwise logsigmoid loss with cost_gap weighted sum aggregation replacing mean",
  "pseudocode": "x = clamp(alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * cost_gap, -20, 20)\nloss = -logsigmoid(x)\nweighted_loss = loss * weight\nfinal_loss = sum(weighted_loss) / (sum(weight) + 1e-8)",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    cost_gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * cost_gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is None:\n        weight = ops.ones_like(loss)\n    weighted_loss = loss * weight\n    loss_sum = ops.sum(weighted_loss)\n    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight) + 1e-8\n    return loss_sum / weight_sum\n"
}

{
  "name": "loss_margin_reweight_advantage_exp",
  "intuition": "Shifts from a pure margin-based pairwise loss to a reweighted margin loss where the pairwise log-probability difference is modulated exponentially by the advantage gap signal, emphasizing pairs with larger relative preference advantages and suppressing weaker ones, encoded with a sigmoid link for smoothness.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\nlpw = batch['log_prob_w']\nlpl = batch['log_prob_l']\nweight = batch.get('weight', None)\nmargin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\nreweight = ops.exp(adv_gap)\nx = ops.mul(margin, reweight)\nloss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\nif weight is not None:\n  loss = loss * weight\nreturn loss.mean()",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_reweighting",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "logsigmoid",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "sub",
    "mul",
    "exp",
    "logsigmoid"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    reweight = ops.exp(adv_gap)\n    x = ops.mul(margin, reweight)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)\n"
}

{
  "name": "loss_contrastive_tanh_advantage_gap",
  "intuition": "Use a contrastive loss paradigm with a tanh link to softly saturate differences in log probabilities scaled by the advantage gap signal, encouraging stronger weighting for pairs with larger advantage differences.",
  "pseudocode": "gap = advantage_w - advantage_l\nscaled_diff = clamp(scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l), -20, 20)\nhardness = tanh(scaled_diff)\nloss = -(gap * hardness) * weight\nreturn mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "contrastive",

    "link_family": "tanh",

      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 2.0))\n    gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    scaled_diff = ops.clamp(ops.mul(scale, diff), -20.0, 20.0)\n    hardness = ops.tanh(scaled_diff)\n    loss = ops.neg(ops.mul(gap, hardness))\n    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

  "intuition": "Use a ranking gap paradigm that models the pairwise preference as a smooth tanh transformation of the advantage gap to directly enforce margin with saturating nonlinearity and weight pairs proportional to advantage gap magnitude.",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))\n    rank_gap = ops.tanh(ops.mul(scale, adv_gap))\n    loss = ops.sub(1.0, rank_gap)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"

{
  "name": "stabilized_cost_logprob_pairwise_loss",
  "intuition": "Simplify the candidate by removing unnecessary detach and redundant scaling, clamp input to logsigmoid to [-20,20] for numerical stability, replace cost gap difference with advantage_gap to directly reflect preferred pairwise signal, combine two stabilized logsigmoid losses (one with cost-sensitive term, one purely logprob difference) with convex weights, ensuring all used keys match expects and vectorized ops are consistent. This reduces instability and enforces semantic correctness by using advantage_gap instead of detached costs, preserving gradient flow and stabilizing the loss.",
  "implementation_hint": {
    "mode": "pairwise",
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ]
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scale1 = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale1', 1.9496803035382082))
    scale2 = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale2', 0.6752757766189963))

    # Compose stabilized first loss term: scaled logprob difference minus cost-sensitive term
    x1 = alpha * scale1 * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * advantage_gap
    x1 = ops.clamp(x1, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss1 = -ops.logsigmoid(x1)

    # Compose stabilized second loss term: scaled logprob difference only
    x2 = alpha * scale2 * (lpw - lpl)
    x2 = ops.clamp(x2, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss2 = -ops.logsigmoid(x2)

    # Weighted average combining two components for stable and semantically grounded loss
    combined_loss = 0.6 * loss1 + 0.4 * loss2

    if weight is not None:
        combined_loss = combined_loss * weight

    return combined_loss.mean()"
}
